note: BLM Ridgecrest Field Office campground on volcanic desert off US-395 at the base of the eastern Sierra, a short walk from the Fossil Falls basalt gorge trail. The BLM calls its sites well suited to medium-sized RVs; tables and fire rings. Summer highs reach 100-120 F. --Claude
summary: Fossil Falls (BLM): $6, 11 first-come sites, 14-day limit, drinking water and restroom confirmed; no rec.gov listing. Pin is on the trailhead lot -> campground loop ~300 m NW.
